monument_name: Gaṇeśa Bhajana Phalcā (originally built in 1505 CE)
description_en: This phalcā is located to south of the Gaṇeśa Mandira (LAL1910) at Su Bāhāḥ Ṭola. It was constructed especially for chanting and singing hymns and devotional songs (bhajana) dedicated to Gaṇeśa who is the area deity (sthānagaṇeśa) of the locality (albeit, no deity is enshrined inside the Phalcā). It has nine bays on its ground floor, which are used by devotees from the locality to performbhajanas.The upper floor of the Phalcā has three windows; the one at the centre is atrikhājhyāḥ. Various items and instruments used for performingbhajanasare stored on this floor.The Phalcā was constructed in 1505 CE (NS 625) on the plots of land endowed by three persons from the Su Bāhāḥ Ṭola—Jivarāma Bhābo, Hṛdāma Bhābo, and Jayarāma Bhābo. The initial construction of the Phalcā took place when a person named Jyoti was thethakāli(seniormost member of theguthi)of a group that used to conductaṣṭamīvrata, a ritual fasting observed on the 8th lunar day. Although it is aphalcāat present, its inscription refers to the building as acapāḥ. In 1626 CE (NS 746), Śivarāma Bhāro commissioned the renovation of thecapāḥand also formed aguthiby a land donation. The Phalcā was renovated again in 1713 CE, i.e., NS 833 (recorded on the inscription issued in NS 833, see the historical events below). This inscription refers to the building as aphalcā. Thecapāḥwas probably converted into aphalcāduring the said renovation. The Phalcā went through another cycle of renovation in VS 2054 (1997 CE).Locals performbhajanasdedicated to Gaṇeśa and various other deities at this Phalcā during the lunar month of Yaṃlā (Bhādra/Āśvina) and the solar month of Māgha. During theYẽnyāḥfestival, a repoussé of Gaṇeśa is exhibited at the sanctum of the Gaṇeśa Temple (LAL1910) in front of the Phalcā. On this occasion,samaybajiis distributed from the Phalcā andbhajanasare performed. The members of theguthisleep at thePhalcafor the security of the Gaṇeśa repoussé on this day.
description_ne: सुबाहाः टोलको गणेश मन्दिर (LAL1910) को दक्षिणमा यो फल्चा रहेको छ । यी गणेश सु बाहाः टोलको थान गणेश हुन् र तिनै गणेशको भजन गर्नको लागि यो फल्चा बनाइएको हो । फल्चाको भुइँतलामा नौवटा कवल बनाइएका छन् । भुइँतलामा कुनै देवीदेवताका मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएका छैनन् । यसै भुइँतलामा भजन गरिन्छ । फल्चाको पहिलो तलामा तीनवटा झ्याल राखिएका छन् । तीनवटा मध्ये बीचमा त्रिखाझ्याल राखिएको छ । यस तलामा भजनसँग सम्बन्धित सामानहरू राखिएका छन् ।यो फल्चा नेसं ६२५ (सन् १५०५) मा निर्माण गरिएको थियो । त्यस कार्यको लागि सुबाहाः टोलमा बस्ने जिवराम भावो, हृदाम भावो र जयराज भावोले मिलेर जग्गा दान दिएका थिए । अष्टमी व्रत समूहमा ज्योति नाम गरेका व्यक्ति थकालि हुँदा यो फल्चा निर्माण गरिएको थियो । अहिले यो फल्चा भएपनि अभिलेखमा यसलाई फल्चा नभनीचपाःभनिएको छ । नेसं ७४६ (सन् १६२६) मा शिवराम भारोले चपाःको जीर्णोद्धार गरी जग्गा गुठी राखिदिएका थिए । नेसं ८३३ (सन् १७१३) मा पुनः फल्चाको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । यस अभिलेखमा चपाः नभनी फल्चा भनिएको छ ।  सम्भवतः नेसं ८३३ मा जीर्णोद्धार गर्दा चपाःलाई फल्चामा परिणत गरिएको हुनसक्छ । विसं २०५४ (सन् १९९७) मा फल्चाको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो ।यस फल्चामा ञंला (भदौ–असोज) र माघ महिनामा गणेशका साथै विभिन्न देव देवीका नाममा भजन गाउने परम्परा छ । इन्द्रजात्राको दिनमा फल्चाको अगाडि रहेको गणेश मन्दिरमा धातुमूर्ति प्रदर्शन गरी समयबजि वितरण गर्ने परम्परा छ । त्यस राति पनि फल्चामा भजन गरिन्छ र गणेशको धातुमूर्ति सुरक्षा गर्न गुठीयारहरू यसै फल्चामा सुत्ने गर्छन् ।

historical_events.event_name: Initial construction of the capāḥ (Gaṇeśa Bhajana Phalcā)
historical_events.event_description: The Phalcā was constructed on the plots of land endowed by three persons from the Su Bāhāḥ Ṭola—Jivarāma Bhābo, Hṛdāma Bhābo, and Jayarāma Bhābo.  Its initial construction took place when a person named Jyoti was thethakāliof a group that used to conductaṣṭamīvrata, a ritual fast observed on the 8thlunar day. Although it is aphalcāat present, its inscription refers to the building as acapāḥ.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of the capāḥ (Phalcā) and land endowment
historical_events.event_description: Śivarāma Bhāro renovated thecapāḥand endowed some plots of land to sponsor the regular offering of oil lamps to Gaṇeśa.
Harisiṅ Bhāvo, Bhāgīsiṅ Bhāvo and others jointly renovated Gaṇeśa Bhajana Phalcā.

historical_events.event_name: Construction of two wells and pavement of road
historical_events.event_description: Sidikisana, Pāhā̃siṃ and others jointly constructed two wells at the Su Bāhāh Ṭola and also paved the road.

The Subāhāḥ Ṭola Sudhāra Samiti renovated the Phalcā with the help of the then Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City, UDL and local residents of the Subāhāḥ Ṭola. Old wood and bricks were used for restoration as much as possible.
